text:
maya: quick unblock request for PR #4821 — CI failing only on shard 6 (integration-large-batch). Small UI snapshot diff too. Need one approver or a plan to proceed.

sam: can you paste the build links?

buildkite-bot: https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/4821 — job matrix: shard0..shard9. shard6: failed (timeout in TestBatcher) twice. others green.

alex: looked at the logs — TestBatcher timed out while waiting for background flush, stack shows: `goroutine 72 [chan receive]:` seems transient. No obvious code regression in this PR.

lina: UI snapshot diff? is it a content change or rendering noise?

maya: snapshot is a 3-line whitespace/spacing change in job list. I tried locally with `make test-snap` and it was identical, so likely CI rendering difference. Not a functional change.

sam: seems like classic flake. Options: 1) run a single-shard rerun for shard6, 2) quarantine the test, 3) update snapshot remotely (but we prefer not to without reviewer signoff).

maya: I'd prefer (1). If shard6 passes on a focused rerun we'll merge. If it fails again, we can open a quick follow-up to quarantine TestBatcher and revert snapshot update.

alex: +1 for single-shard rerun. How do we trigger that?

maya: use the rerun command in Buildkite: `bk rerun --job=4821/shard6` (you can also click the single-job rerun in the UI). I'll queue it now.

buildkite-bot: Rerun queued for job 4821/shard6 — https://buildkite.com/redwood/prs/4821/builds/5492 (started).

lina: I'll give a quick eye if the rerun passes and snapshot diff is still whitespace. If it's green and diff is trivial, I'm fine approving the merge. :eyes:

sam: heads-up: our merge window opens in 45m. If rerun is green, can we fast-track?

maya: noted. I'll ping here immediately on finish. If green and no other approvals missing, merge within the window. If rerun flakes again, I'll open a short issue and request an SRE-quarantine.

buildkite-bot: Rerun finished — shard6: PASSED.

maya: ✅ shard6 passed on rerun. UI snapshot still shows whitespace delta in CI-only render. Lina, can you approve?

lina: approved. :shipit: small nonfunctional whitespace change ok.

sam: merging now. Thanks all for quick turnaround.

maya: thanks! I'll follow up with a tiny note in the PR description about the flaky TestBatcher and add an item to our flaky-tests board to monitor.
